note: One entry per board id in data/boards.csv. Source of the 'When the board stops answering' sections in each board's AGENTS.md and FAQ.md (tools/recovery_table.py) and of docs/remote-board-recovery.md. Only facts the repo records. kind is remote (the Mac can do it with the board in place) or hands (a person presses, unplugs or moves something). status is proven, failed or untested; a method that worked for one lockup and failed for another is two rows. evidence is a list of repo paths; date is the day it was seen (null where the repo does not record it); note is free text. Update the entry the day a lockup or a recovery happens, and bump checked.

The probe left nRST held low after a connect under reset; every connect fails until it is released

Second lockout after the ported tima_timer_mode_pwm_dead_band: the debug port answers, BOOTDIAG cycles (0x07 = nested exception, CCStudio GEL) and the loop resets the debug logic too, so AP0 flickers and power-AP holds do not stick; restored 2026-10-24 by DSSM factory reset

Third lockout after the ported smbus_smbus_controller (G3507 port): the debug port answers (DPIDR 0x6ba02477), the core is not examined (CPUID reads 0x0), the same signature as the second lockout; restored 2026-10-25 by DSSM factory reset, oob-flash.bin written back

Fourth lockout after the ported L1306 spi_controller_internal_loopback_poll (it passed preflight; SPI0 on PA2, PA11, PA16, PA18): repeated external reset, the debug port answers (DPIDR 0x6ba02477) and no MEM-AP is found; recovered the same day by the DSSM factory reset (0x020A), oob-flash.bin written and read back equal, nRST start, PA22 497 ms

memory.source: units are 16-bit words (C28x). C2000Ware 26.02 device_support/f280013x/common/cmd/280013x_flash_api_lnk.cmd (RAMM0 0x128, RAMM1 0x400, RAMLS0+LS1 0x8000-0xBFF8, flash 0x80000-0x9FFF0 in 8-sector groups of 0x2000, last 0x10 words reserved by an errata note, BEGIN 0x80000) and driverlib hw_memmap.h (DCSM_Z1OTP_BASE 0x78000, DCSM_Z2OTP_BASE 0x78200); flash is 128 sectors of 1 KW. OTP extents are conservative (c2000-launchpad/FAQ.md saw an image reach 0x78220); TRM section not re-read
